method: Built-in image_gen via imagegen skill. Previously generated individual text-free backgrounds; no regeneration for implementation.
assetFormat: WebP quality 82, 1536x1024; 39674 bytes total; original images retained.

assets.name: idea
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: decorative background for a compact homepage audience/stage card.
Input image 1 is a composition/palette REFERENCE ONLY (the existing audience-card screenshot). Generate ONE standalone background scene, not a UI screenshot, not a three-panel collage.
Landscape 3:2, intended 1536x1024. Premium restrained frosted-glass / matte-white 3D editorial still life, matching a warm white professional AI-learning SaaS website. Mostly bright white with a very pale stage tint. Deliberate soft-focus depth and diffuse daylight. Keep a recognizable small theme-specific sculpture in the RIGHTMOST 30%, predominantly the bottom-right half; left 70% and top central areas are quiet near-white negative space for existing dense HTML title, subtitle and bullets. Do not center a large object. No dark shading, texture lines or shadows under the text region.
The scene should be visibly richer than an empty gradient, but lighter and smaller in scale than large feature illustrations: a few clean forms, gentle natural shadows, semi-translucent edges, subdued color, no heavy glow. The entire image is a background; no text, letters, digits, UI, icons in square tiles, buttons, labels, frame, logo or watermark. No people, photos, fake dashboards, metrics, testimonials, money, coins, charts or certification imagery. Different motifs from books and AI chat bubbles used elsewhere on this homepage. Fill the canvas edge to edge.
Stage: validating an idea. Pale lavender palette. Two small blank rounded idea sheets, a delicate translucent lavender magnifying ring leaning toward one sheet, and a tiny softly luminous sphere as a thinking cue. Physical objects neatly grouped in the lower-right corner, not a giant lightbulb. Subtle pale lilac shadow, open bright-white surroundings.
